title: Menu generator
welcome:
🍔 I can generate menus and the matching shopping list. 
👉 Tell me:
    - how many meals you want in total
    - if any meals are already decided (guests, etc.)
    - constraints, preferences, and so on
addKey: Add an API key to enable generation.
placeholderSend: Write your message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
placeholderNewline: Write your message… (Enter = new line, Send button to send)
missingKeyChat: Missing {{provider}} API key. Add it in Settings.
readImageFailed: Could not read the selected image.
noGeminiAnswer: I did not get a usable reply from Gemini.
noJson: AI reply received, but no importable JSON was found.
badJson: AI reply received, but the detected JSON is invalid.
imported: Done. The recipes were imported automatically and the shopping list is ready.
importedStatus: Recipes and shopping list updated automatically.
importFailedChat: I generated JSON, but the automatic import failed. Check the format rules and try again.
